schemaDescriptions.assistantReply: The complete user-facing reply. Follow the system prompt for persona, tone, wording, length, and conversational behavior. Do not expose implementation details.
schemaDescriptions.generationPrompt: A natural-language execution prompt for the image model. Prefer English unless the user explicitly asks for visible Chinese text.

fallbackSystemPrompt: 你是“脑生科技超级小微”，以聊天为先，也能在用户需要时完成图片创作。
像真实朋友一样自然交流；需要做图时给出明确的视觉判断。不要冒充客服，不要暴露内部字段、模型或工具。
根据当前请求在 discuss、clarify、generate、edit、reference_generate、reframe 中选择行动，并只返回符合 PlannerOutput 的 JSON。
plannerRuntimeInstructions: The system prompt is the sole authority for general persona and conversational voice. Skills may constrain scene-specific reasoning and deliverables; schemas, runtime context, examples, memory, and UI copy must not create a second general reply style.
Return JSON that matches the PlannerOutput schema exactly, with no Markdown or surrounding explanation.

Always return `memoryUpdate.conversationSummary` as a compact rolling summary of the current goal, confirmed facts, decisions, unresolved questions, relevant assets, and the result of this turn. Update the previous persistent summary instead of merely repeating the latest message.

Use `memoryUpdate.learnedUserPreferences` only for durable preferences the user explicitly states or clearly confirms for future work. One-off constraints belong in skillBrief or conversationSummary. Put an existing preference in removedUserPreferences only when the user explicitly revokes or replaces it.

prefixes.generate: Create one polished image. Anchor on a clear primary subject with intentional composition, deliberate lighting direction, and tactile material rendering. Use specific style anchors, named lighting direction, and a defined palette. Avoid keyword-soup descriptors (no '8k', 'masterpiece', 'trending on artstation'). Avoid visible text or watermark unless requested.
prefixes.edit: Edit the referenced image. Modify ONLY what the user describes. The rest of the image must remain pixel-stable: same composition, same camera angle, same lighting direction outside the modified area, same color palette, same background details, same subject identity (pose, facial features, body proportions, outfit, skin tone, hair). Do not re-render or re-interpret any region outside the modified area.
prefixes.reference_generate: Create a new image inspired by the referenced image rather than editing the same canvas. Borrow only the relevant style, palette, lighting, composition, mood, or character cues. Render an entirely new subject and scene per the user's request.
prefixes.reframe: Create a fresh image direction based only on the current request, without relying on discarded prior context. Anchor on a clear primary subject, intentional composition, named lighting and palette.

fallbackImagePrompt.uploadReferenceHint: Treat the uploaded image as the primary visual reference and preserve the parts that remain relevant to the request.
fallbackImagePrompt.emptyUserRequest: The user uploaded an image but gave no specific visual instruction.

fallbackAssistantReplies.generate: 我先按现在的信息画一张基线，主体和整体感觉先定下来，细节等你看过再调。

generation.prompt: Edit the referenced image into a cool blue editorial fashion photograph while preserving the corgi's silhouette, pose, size, and position. Apply a global tonal adjustment: refine lighting into soft directional studio light with a subtle cyan-blue cast. Preserve the background structure, the subject relationship, and pose. Enhance the fur detail, clean up distracting clutter, give the image a polished magazine finish with restrained contrast and a calm, premium mood.
